name: How long does a typical door frame repair take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical door frame repair take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a door frame repair varies significantly based on the extent and type of damage. Minor repairs, such as patching small holes or fixing a loose hinge, might only take a few hours. More extensive work, like replacing a rotted section of a jamb or repairing significant structural damage, could take a full day or sometimes even two, especially if custom materials or painting/finishing are involved. An accurate estimate can be provided after a professional assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair time depends on damage severity. Minor fixes may take hours, while extensive repairs or section replacements can take one to two days.
